warnings: Generic component parameters and control assumptions; not manufacturer calibrated.
Outdoor metal and retained water/ice share one equilibrium temperature.
Ice sublimation is excluded; retained ice melts or receives deposition.
Dirt uses clear-passage scaling of air flow/air-side conductance; forced fan power is constant without a measured fan curve.
Pipe model assumes smooth copper, homogeneous two-phase flow and outdoor ambient along the whole field line; slip, fittings and oil are excluded.

Idealized parallel indoor coils use generic demand-proportional flow for inverter operation, UA allocation for fixed-speed/defrost and retained minimum-on paths, and actual branch outlets; the mixed header meets the shared outlet target. Physical field-line heating retains per-branch subcooling control.
Generic inverter startup, ramp, envelope supervision and restart dwell override demand; stopped forecasts are control estimates, not sensor states.
Scenario edit added/removed stored energy and water; recorded as a configuration boundary impulse.
Interzone links exchange sensible heat through prescribed conductance; they do not transport air/water or resolve buoyancy.
Internal gains are prescribed sensible heat supplied to room air, separate from HVAC output and COP.
